title: Congressional source puts crash-retrieval programs near 100% likely

tellings.quote: this. I talked to a a congressional source told me um I asked point blank, what's your confidence level in in the existence of such programs? The answer was hovering around 100%.

plain: Secret US programs to recover crashed craft that did not come from people are almost certain to exist, according to a source in Congress. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff says that in the 2020s he asked this unnamed source point blank how confident they were that such programs exist, and that "the answer was hovering around 100%." If true, it would mean someone inside Congress believes the government holds such craft.
